unitTitle: Greet, be polite, spell your name
title: Grammar: avoir: to have
subtitle: Unit 2: Greet, be polite, spell your name

steps.title: avoir: to have
steps.body: avoir is the second most important verb. It also gives you age: in French you have years, you are not years.

steps.title: Watch out
steps.body: Age uses avoir, never être: J'ai trente ans (I have thirty years). Never Je suis trente ans. In English you are 30; in French you have 30. Also: ils ont (they have) sounds like ils sont (they are) apart from the first sound. Listen for the z: ils ont is eel-ZOH(N), ils sont is eel-SOH(N).
